title: From Delivery Outputs to Inputs: DORA, DevEx, and Beyond

blocks.html: I’ll explore how leading tech organizations are redefining developer productivity by moving beyond traditional output metrics to focus on the day-to-day factors that shape developer experience and influence delivery speed, ease, and quality. Drawing from conversations with industry leaders, I will share actionable insights and real-world examples that highlight strategies for improving team clarity, reducing friction, and boosting efficiency in today’s dynamic engineering landscape.
